title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Matthew 22: the king's wedding feast, the question about Caesar's tax, the Sadducees on the resurrection, and the greatest commandment.

questions.text: What was the feast in the parable of the king?
questions.explanation: The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who made a wedding feast for his son.

answers.text: A harvest feast for his servants
A feast for the elders of the city
A wedding feast for his son
A feast at the end of a journey

questions.text: What did those who were invited do instead of coming?
questions.explanation: They made light of it and went their ways, one to his own farm and another to his merchandise.

answers.text: They made light of it and went their ways
They sent gifts to the king in their place
They came but would not eat the dinner
They asked the king to wait a year

questions.text: Whom did the servants gather from the highways?
questions.explanation: The servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good, and the wedding was filled with guests.

answers.text: Only the poor of the city
Only those who had been invited first
The elders and the scribes
As many as they found, both bad and good

questions.text: What did the king notice about one of the guests?
questions.explanation: When the king came in to see the guests, he saw a man who did not have on wedding clothing, and the man was speechless.

answers.text: That he had come without a gift
That he did not have on wedding clothing
That he sat in the place of honor
That he would not eat the dinner

questions.text: How did Jesus end this parable?
questions.explanation: He ended by saying that many are called, but few chosen.

answers.text: Many are called, but few chosen
The feast will be made ready again
The servants will sit with the king
The city will be rebuilt

questions.text: What did the Pharisees' disciples and the Herodians ask Jesus?
questions.explanation: After calling him honest, they asked whether it is lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not.

answers.text: Whether a man may divorce his wife
Whether they should fast on the Sabbath
Whether it is lawful to pay taxes to Caesar
Whether John's baptism was from heaven

questions.text: What did Jesus say after they told him the image on the coin was Caesar's?
questions.explanation: He told them to give to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's.

answers.text: That the coin should be left in the temple treasury
To give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's
That they should pay no taxes to Caesar at all
That the image on the coin should be broken

questions.text: What did the Sadducees ask about the woman who had been married to seven brothers?
questions.explanation: They said that seven brothers each had her in turn and then she died, and they asked whose wife she would be of the seven in the resurrection.

answers.text: Which brother had sinned
Whether she could marry again
How her inheritance should be divided
Whose wife she would be in the resurrection

questions.text: What did Jesus say about people in the resurrection?
questions.explanation: He said that in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God's angels in heaven.

answers.text: They are like God's angels in heaven
They keep the households they had on earth
They are given new names by the prophets
They are gathered to the city of David

questions.text: What did Jesus call the first and great commandment?
questions.explanation: He said the first and great commandment is to love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.

answers.text: To keep the Sabbath day holy in the land
To love the Lord your God with all your heart
To honor your father and your mother always
To love your neighbor as you love yourself
